name: saju-math-engine
description: Data-driven, math-first Four Pillars (Saju / Bazi) calculation engine with stable API contracts.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-build-assets.mjs && node tools/verify-dist-package.mjs
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:kasi && npm run validate:xref
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci && npm run validate:all
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run test:release-tools && npm run validate:school-sources
